resources.string: In Chrome: Settings → Autofill services → Autofill using another service, then restart Chrome.
Check provider status and try an Autofill-compatible OTP field.
Tap Request OTP Autofill, then select Get SMS verification code. This native test helps check whether a browser or website is preventing Autofill. It does not send an SMS.
TypoDev is selected as the Autofill provider.
TypoDev is not selected as the Autofill provider.
The app or browser did not expose a recognizable OTP field.
The app already has its own SMS retrieval request; TypoDev cannot offer a competing prompt.
Google OTP access was denied. Check SMS verification-code settings in Google settings on your phone.
Google OTP API is unavailable or did not respond. Check Google Play services and the selected Autofill provider.
OTP suggestion returned to Android. If it is hidden, check the app or browser Autofill settings.
